factual_claims.claim: Profit after tax was DKK 0.9 million, down from DKK 10.6 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Income Statement: Profit/loss for the year 2025: 869,196 DKK (~0.9m) vs 2024: 10,601,388 DKK (~10.6m).

factual_claims.claim: The effective tax rate rose to 70%, which the report relates to the non-utilization of tax assets, including tax loss carryforwards.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 9: Effective tax rate 2025: 70%... The high tax on profit comes from not utilization of tax assets (tax loss carryforward).

factual_claims.claim: Cash generation remained solid.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: Cash flow remain at a strong level.

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow from operating activities was DKK 28.5 million, compared with DKK 29.4 million in 2024, supported by improved net working capital, particularly inventories and work in progress.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement: Cash flow from operating activities 2025: 28,460,663 DKK (~28.5m) vs 2024: 29,430,925 DKK (~29.4m). Management's Review: The decrease is primarily attributable to the decrease in activity/revenue however it has been possible to improve the net working capital – mainly on inventories and Work in Progress.

factual_claims.claim: Investing cash outflow decreased to DKK 9.4 million from DKK 17.6 million, with investments focused mainly on digitalization and IT infrastructure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement: Cash flow from investing activities 2025: -9,374,141 DKK (~-9.4m) vs 2024: -17,593,686 DKK (~-17.6m). Management's Review: Main investments have been boosting digitalization (lead generation, software development, support to process automation etc) and full update of the IT network and firewall setup.

factual_claims.claim: Year-end cash increased to DKK 4.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement: Cash and cash equivalents end of year 2025: 4,009,029 DKK (~4.0m).

factual_claims.claim: Net interest-bearing debt rose to DKK 38.7 million from DKK 36.7 million, and gearing increased to 1.7 from 1.2, remaining below the target of 2.0.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: Net interest-bearing debt at the end of 2025 amounted to DKK 38.7m (End of 2024: DKK 36.7m). Financial gearing calculated as NIBD/EBITDA amounted to 1.7 at the end of 2025. (End of 2024: 1.2). The target is to be below 2.0.

factual_claims.claim: Equity declined to DKK 32.5 million from DKK 36.6 million, and the net-cash equity ratio was 23.5% versus 24.8%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Balance Sheet: Equity 2025: 32,472,860 DKK (~32.5m) vs 2024: 36,634,652 DKK (~36.6m). Management's Review: At the end of 2025, equity amounted to DKK 32.5m (End of 2024: DKK 36.6), equivalent to an equity ratio of 23.5% (net cash). The target is to be above 25%.

factual_claims.claim: Market activity improved as interest rates stabilized, particularly in non-residential construction, while residential demand remained subdued.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review: As interest rates stabilized during 2025, market activity improved, particularly in the second half of the year... Within the non-residential segment, project execution accelerated... demand in the residential market remained more subdued...

factual_claims.claim: For 2026, management expects organic revenue growth of 7–14% to DKK 290–310 million and EBITDA of DKK 45–55 million, with continued uncertainty around project timing, economic conditions and geopolitical developments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook for 2026: Revenue is expected to grow organically by 7-14% in 2026... to DKK 290-310m, while EBITDA is expected to increase to DKK 45-55m... The outlook for 2026 is characterized by a high degree of uncertainty... Unforeseen events such as geopolitical uncertainty and supply disruptions may impact developments in 2026.
